title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.31130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline tests can fail to reveal whether an agent update will remain safe after deployment. We operationalize this post-audit mirage using matched safe and harmful lifecycles that expose identical verifier-visible evidence while an isolated scorer records opposite deployment truth. Our theorem applies standard observational-equivalence and indistinguishability ideas to this executable audit boundary and states the resulting error-abstention tradeoff. The Post-Audit Mirage benchmark makes that boundary executable across authorization, scheduling, and shared-capacity environments. IdentifiedRangeMonitor uses fresh group-labelled harm outcomes to return deploy, hold, cannot determine, or unsupported. Experiments show that monitoring can recover the missing distinction in favorable settings but may remain undecided for rare groups, small effects, or missing observations. translated_title: 审计后幻象：离线智能体验证的可识别性极限
translated_abstract: 离线测试可能无法揭示智能体更新在部署后是否仍然安全。我们通过构建匹配的安全与有害生命周期来操作化这种“审计后幻象”——这些生命周期向验证者暴露完全相同的可见证据，而一个隔离运行的评分器却记录到截然相反的部署真实结果。我们的定理将标准的观察等价与不可区分性思想应用于这一可执行的审计边界，并给出了由此产生的错误-弃权权衡。Post-Audit Mirage 基准使这一边界在授权、调度和共享容量环境中变得可执行。IdentifiedRangeMonitor 利用新鲜的组标记危害结果来返回“部署”、“保留”、“无法确定”或“不支持”四种决策。实验表明，监控在有利设置下可以恢复缺失的区分，但对于稀有群体、小效应或缺失观测，可能仍然无法做出判定。因此，验证器-智能体评估必须同时测试计算有效性……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了离线智能体验证存在根本性的可识别性极限——安全与不安全的智能体生命周期在离线审计中可能完全无法区分——并通过可执行的基准测试与基于组标记危害结果的监控方法，刻画了监控在何种条件下能够或无法恢复部署后缺失的安全性区分。
en_tdlr: This paper proves fundamental identifiability limits of offline agent verification—safe and unsafe agent lifecycles can expose identical verifier-visible evidence—and introduces an executable benchmark plus a group-labeled monitor that characterize when monitoring can or cannot recover the missing post-deployment safety distinction.
